01 研究問題與正式結果範圍

本研究比較六種迴歸方法在小樣本縱向資料中的還原能力。兩份模擬使用已知的資料生成機制，分別檢查因子排序、影響函數、預測，以及成對變數的方向證據。每個問題使用各自的評分目標；本文按任務呈現全部情境與模型結果。

1.1 兩份模擬回答的問題

研究一（Core）：在 14 個候選因子中，模型能否找回真正進入結果生成式的因子？找回因子後，能否還原線性、平滑非線性、斜率轉折與效果修飾？模型對新個體，以及已有追蹤歷史的個體，能提供多少預測能力？

研究二（Direction）：給定調整變數後，A 與 B 是否仍提供彼此的增額預測資訊？共同的證據規則何時畫出 A→BA\to BA→B 或 B→AB\to AB→A，何時保留方向未定？在已知生成方向的評分條件下，各迴歸方法能否還原影響曲線與效果修飾？

一個 replicate 是一次重新生成、重新擬合、重新評分的完整模擬。六模型在同一次 replicate 共用資料與評分條件，因此比較可以配對。表中的次數只包含正式結果；開發、校準與補充診斷另外說明。

本模擬研究為作者與國立臺灣大學醫院合作專題的一部分，但並未使用任何患者資訊。模擬所用資料皆為合成資料；本頁呈現合成資料的生成設定、評估方法與彙總結果。

02 比較方法與共同實作原則

2.1 六種迴歸方法

  • Mean：以訓練目標的平均值作常數預測。
  • LMM：以線性固定效果與個體隨機截距描述結果；已有追蹤歷史時使用估計的個體效果。
  • GAM：使用加法 spline 基底與 ridge 懲罰估計影響函數。
  • RF：以多棵迴歸樹的平均值作預測。
  • GPR：以核函數描述輸入之間的相似程度，估計函數與預測值。
  • MERF：交替估計森林固定部分與個體隨機截距；已有追蹤歷史時使用估計的個體效果。

2.2 相同資訊與個體分組

六模型共用每次生成的資料、分組切分與參考資料。ID 用於分組、隨機效果與評分，不當作一般數值特徵。中位數補值、缺失指示欄、輸入尺度與目標尺度等轉換都只在對應的訓練資料上估計，再套用於保留資料。模型擬合不接收真因子名單、真曲線或真箭頭。

各模型共用相同資料與可用資訊；模型自由度、計算成本，以及研究一的樹數依表 2 設定。RF 與 MERF 的比較涵蓋整套模型規格，而非單獨改變隨機截距的對照實驗。

3.3 影響函數、替身、缺失與污染

三種基礎函數

hlinear(x)=x,hsmooth(x)=0.8sin⁡(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),hhinge(x)=max⁡(0,x−0.25).\begin{aligned}h_{\mathrm{linear}}(x)&=x,\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(x)&=0.8\sin(\pi x/2)+0.2(x^2-1),\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{hinge}}(x)&=\max(0,x-0.25).\end{aligned}hlinear​(x)hsmooth​(x)hhinge​(x)​=x,=0.8sin(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),=max(0,x−0.25).​

函數的中心化與標準化

h~q(x)=hq(x)−E[hq(G)]SD⁡[hq(G)],G∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.\begin{aligned}\widetilde h_q(x)&=\frac{h_q(x)-\mathbb{E}[h_q(G)]}{\operatorname{SD}[h_q(G)]},\\[0.9em]G&\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1),\qquad q\in\{\mathrm{linear},\mathrm{smooth},\mathrm{hinge}\}.\end{aligned}hq​(x)G​=SD[hq​(G)]hq​(x)−E[hq​(G)]​,∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.​

正式結果式使用 h~smooth\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}hsmooth​ 與 h~hinge\widetilde h_{\mathrm{hinge}}hhinge​ 等標準化函數，再乘情境指定的係數；標準化常數使用固定 64 點 Gauss–Hermite 積分。這是以標準常態輸入校準函數，實際 X 的分布仍由上節生成。各情境的實現訊號變異與 R2R^2R2 同時受函數形式與輸入分布影響。S4 的第一函數另乘 (1+0.75DM)(1+0.75\mathrm{DM})(1+0.75DM)，第二函數為線性；其他雙因子情境的第二係數預設是第一係數的 2/3，F1 改為 0.35 倍，F3 改為 0.50 倍。

3.4 全部主情境與樣本量敏感度

下列 10 個主情境與 5 個敏感度設定均已完成正式模擬。每個條件塊列出生成設定、研究目的與結果說明；各設定的全模型數值見第 4 節。

S0 無額外生物標記訊號R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
檢查在沒有真生物標記因子的條件下，模型是否仍產生虛假的重要性或曲線。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。真生物標記數為 0，所有生物標記的直接效應係數均為 0；共同背景效應仍保留。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
S0 的預測目標包含共同背景效應，評估項目為預測誤差與無直接效應生物標記的重要性。真因子集合為空，完整集合還原率與真因子曲線誤差列為不適用。

S1 單一線性效應R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
建立函數形式最簡單的有訊號對照，檢查因子辨識與線性曲線還原。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應為 0.60hlinear(X1)=0.60X10.60 h_{\mathrm{linear}}(X_1)=0.60X_10.60hlinear​(X1​)=0.60X1​。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
與 S2、S3 比較時，樣本量、噪音參數及結構係數保持相同，以評估模型對線性、平滑與門檻函數的還原能力。各情境的訊號變異由相應函數與實際 X 分布共同決定。

S2 單一平滑非線性效應R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
檢查模型是否能辨識真因子並還原彎曲的平均反應，同時作為樣本量敏感度的共同基準。
模擬條件
訓練資料為 50 個合成個體，每人 4 次訪視，共 200 個預定觀測；月份為 3、6、9、12。候選生物標記共 14 個，另有 8 個共同背景變數。唯一真因子為 X1X_1X1​，直接效應為 0.60h~smooth(X1)0.60\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(X_1)0.60hsmooth​(X1​)。h~smooth\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}hsmooth​ 由 0.80sin⁡(πx/2)+0.20(x2−1)0.80\sin(\pi x/2)+0.20(x^2-1)0.80sin(πx/2)+0.20(x2−1) 在標準常態下中心化並標準化而得。隨機截距與殘差部分的 ICC 參數為 0.25，殘差標準差為 0.70。未設定與真因子高度相關的誘餌變數。未加入生物標記缺失、訪視退出或額外離群污染。所有觀測結果依共同生成程序截斷至 [0,8][0,8][0,8]。
解讀重點
此情境以完整集合還原率評估因子辨識，以 ALE 誤差評估平滑曲線還原，並分別計算新個體與已知個體的預測誤差。

3.5 每次模擬的完整流程

  1. 生成共同訓練與獨立考卷。按情境生成訓練資料，另生成 2,000 個新 ID 的測試資料；兩者都套用指定缺失、流失與污染。
  2. 在訓練資料內選擇設定。GAM、RF、GPR、MERF 以 3-fold GroupKFold 分組驗證，比較 ID 等權 MSE；最小者勝出，再於全訓練資料擬合。Mean／LMM 只有一個候選設定，沒有候選搜尋。
  3. 新個體預測。以共同測試資料評分；LMM／MERF 對新 ID 使用零個體效果。主要 latent 目標為 μ\muμ；觀測結果的 RMSE、MAE、R2R^2R2 另保存。
  4. 因子與函數還原。從獨立測試資料的完整 latent 資料取前 250 ID。以同一考卷對因子作 ID 軌跡區塊 permutation，每因子 3 次；以 20 個分位數區間計算模型與真函數 ALE。
  5. 已追蹤個體任務。另外從原訓練資料保留每個合資格 ID 的最後一筆觀測，僅用更早歷史重新調參與擬合。評分時提供最後一筆的當次 X，LMM／MERF 可使用該 ID 的估計效果；目標為 μ+b\mu+bμ+b。
  6. 保存與彙總。保存指標、警告與完成狀態；跨 replicate 計算平均與 MCSE。同一次 replicate 的模型差值配對彙總。

3.6 指標的數學定義

以第 rrr 次 replicate 的真因子集合 KrK_rKr​、模型重要性前 kkk 名集合 TrT_rTr​ 定義全中指標 Er=1{Tr=Kr}E_r=\mathbf{1}\{T_r=K_r\}Er​=1{Tr​=Kr​}，k=∣Kr∣k=|K_r|k=∣Kr​∣。Exact recovery 為 1R∑r=1REr\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}E_rR1​∑r=1R​Er​。重要性是 permutation 前後對 μ\muμ 的 MSE 增量，除以乾淨合成結果變異。AP 綜合真因子在整份排名中的位置；family recovery 容許指定同族替身代表訊號來源。S0 的 k=0k=0k=0，Mean 亦無因子排序，故相關指標未定義。

標準化 ALE 誤差

ALEerrorr,kCore=1J∑j=1J(A^r,k,j−Ar,k,j)2sY,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Core}}_{r,k}=\frac{\sqrt{\frac{1}{J}\sum_{j=1}^{J}(\widehat A_{r,k,j}-A_{r,k,j})^2}}{s_{Y,r}}.ALEerrorr,kCore​=sY,r​J1​∑j=1J​(Ar,k,j​−Ar,k,j​)2​​.

新個體的 latent RMSE

LatentRMSErnew=1n∑i,t(y^it−μit)2.\mathrm{LatentRMSE}^{\mathrm{new}}_r=\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i,t}(\widehat y_{it}-\mu_{it})^2}.LatentRMSErnew​=n1​i,t∑​(y​it​−μit​)2​.

A^\widehat AA、A 分別為模型與真函數的中心化 ALE；先以區間人數加權中心化，再對有效格點等權計算誤差，sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​ 是完整乾淨參考結果的 SD。雙真因子先在同一 replicate 內平均兩因子誤差，再作跨 replicate 彙總。已追蹤任務把 latent 目標換成 μ+b\mu+bμ+b。主表的 latent RMSE 以保留的評分列計算；觀測誤差的 ID 等權版本另存在下載表。

S4 以第一因子第 5–95 百分位的 15 點，與 DM∈{0,1}\mathrm{DM}\in\{0,1\}DM∈{0,1} 形成 30 個組合；對各組合在共同參考資料上平均預測，整個表面中心化後與真表面比較，再除以 sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​。此指標評估包含主效應的完整聯合反應面。

05 研究二：成對方向與影響方式的設計

5.1 合成來源、目標與共同原因

每次生成 50 個 ID、月份 3、6、9、12。用 SSS 表示當次生成方向的來源、TTT 表示目標；顯示名稱 A／B 依 replicate 輪替。控制集合 C=(MonthScaled,Age,Sex,DM,HTN,CKD,Z)C=(\mathrm{MonthScaled},\mathrm{Age},\mathrm{Sex},\mathrm{DM},\mathrm{HTN},\mathrm{CKD},Z)C=(MonthScaled,Age,Sex,DM,HTN,CKD,Z)。

來源變數

5.2 全部正式情境

D0 調整後無直接關係R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
測量沒有額外 A–B 直接關係時，共同證據流程誤畫箭頭的比例。
模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應函數 f(S,Z)=0f(S,Z)=0f(S,Z)=0。A、B 仍有共同調整變數造成的背景變化，但沒有額外共同原因。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。個體層與訪視層的創新項均為 Gaussian。未加入 A/B 缺失、訪視退出或離群污染。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。
解讀重點
D0 的生成圖沒有 A–B 直接邊。結果按 no_edge、unresolved、false_arrow 與 invalid 四種決策狀態彙總，並以 false_arrow 比例衡量錯誤定向。

D1 線性 Gaussian 的方向不可辨識對照R=200R = 200R=200

研究目的
檢查當既有假設不足以唯一決定方向時，流程是否保留不確定性。
模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應為 f(S,Z)=±0.60Sf(S,Z)=\pm0.60Sf(S,Z)=±0.60S。來源與目標噪音使用匹配的縱向相關結構；生成器標記此情境的方向為不可辨識。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。個體層與訪視層的創新項均為 Gaussian。未加入 A/B 缺失、訪視退出或離群污染。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。
解讀重點
A、B 具有增額預測關係；方向評估將 D1 歸入不可辨識對照，出箭頭的決策計入 false_arrow。結果彙總出箭頭、保留未定與未偵測到增額關係的比例。

D2 線性非 Gaussian 創新項R=225R = 225R=225

研究目的
比較 D1，檢查改變噪音分布後，殘差不對稱證據是否能支援方向判斷。
模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應仍為 f(S,Z)=±0.60Sf(S,Z)=\pm0.60Sf(S,Z)=±0.60S。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。來源、目標與 Z 的個體層及訪視層創新項皆改為 Laplace⁡(0,1)/2\operatorname{Laplace}(0,1)/\sqrt{2}Laplace(0,1)/2​，使各基礎創新項的變異為 1。未加入 A/B 缺失、訪視退出或離群污染。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。
解讀重點
D1 與 D2 的設計差異為創新項分布。D2 以正確箭頭、錯誤箭頭、保留未定、未偵測關係與 invalid 的比例，評估此 Laplace 創新設定下的方向判斷。

模擬條件
每次生成 50 個合成個體，每人於第 3、6、9、12 月觀測，共 200 個預定觀測。共同調整集合 C 包含時間、Age、Sex、DM、HTN、CKD 與 Z；未設定 Core 式的候選生物標記或誘餌。直接效應與 D3 相同：f(S,Z)=±0.60tanh⁡(S)/0.628f(S,Z)=\pm0.60\tanh(S)/0.628f(S,Z)=±0.60tanh(S)/0.628。創新項的 ICC 參數為 0.25；來源的總創新標準差為 1，目標為 0.70，兩者的個體內相關結構使用相同 ICC。個體層與訪視層的創新項均為 Gaussian。每個個體獨立以 0.20 機率失去後兩次訪視，退出個體數由 Bernoulli 抽樣決定；A、B 各欄獨立以 clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.451{second-half visit}],0,0.90)\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathbf{1}_{\{\text{second-half visit}\}}],0,0.90)clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.451{second-half visit}​],0,0.90) 產生 MAR 缺失。每個預定觀測獨立以 0.05 機率在目標加入隨機正負 3 的污染；污染先於退出與缺失。結果使用中性合成單位，沒有 [0,8][0,8][0,8] 截斷。

方向流程使用 A、B 皆觀測到的完整配對列。此情境同時加入訪視退出、兩欄 MAR 缺失與目標污染，以完整方向決策分布和曲線誤差評估聯合資料品質條件。

此情境的局部效果修飾診斷包含平均 ALE、Z=−0.50Z=-0.50Z=−0.50 與 Z=0.75Z=0.75Z=0.75 的中心化曲線差，以及完整條件反應面誤差，分別評估平均效應、交互作用對比和條件函數還原。

D9 的每個 ID 獨立以 0.20 機率移除後半訪視；A／B 各以 clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0,0.90)\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathrm{late}],0,0.90)clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0,0.90) 機率缺失；每個原排程目標以 0.05 機率加 ±3\pm3±3。實現平均約保留 179.9 列，單格缺失 19.0%，任一 A／B 缺失 33.8%。這些條件與 Core 固定人數流失、正向污染不同。

5.3 三折 cross-fitting 與方向證據

  1. 建立共同完整 A/B 資料列。方向流程對缺失 A／B 使用 complete-pair 分析；不補造缺失的目標。六模型與兩方向使用相同資料列。
  2. 依 ID 分成三折。每折用其餘 ID 擬合 A∼CA\sim CA∼C、B∼CB\sim CB∼C、A∼C+BA\sim C+BA∼C+B、B∼C+AB\sim C+AB∼C+A 四個迴歸；所有轉換僅在訓練折估計。保留 ID 的 LMM／MERF 預測不使用該 ID 的估計隨機效果。
  3. 合併 out-of-fold 預測。同一 ID 內 viv_ivi​ 列的每列權重為 wit=1NIDviw_{it}=\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{ID}}v_i}wit​=NID​vi​1​，使每個 ID 總權重相同。
  4. 計算增額改善與殘差相依。相對 RMSE 改善衡量候選來源是否提供額外資訊；兩方向的殘差 kernel alignment 形成方向 margin。
  5. 套用事前凍結門檻。輸出未偵測增額關係、方向未定、A→BA\to BA→B、B→AB\to AB→A 或 invalid；保留連續 gain 與 margin。
  6. 獨立評分形狀。以已知生成方向與另生成的 200 個乾淨參考 ID 計算曲線誤差；真方向只用於評分，不進入方向決策。

單向增額預測改善

gA→B=RMSEB∼C−RMSEB∼C+ARMSEB∼C.g_{A\to B}=\frac{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}-\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C+A}}{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}}.gA→B​=RMSEB∼C​RMSEB∼C​−RMSEB∼C+A​​.

兩方向的平均改善

gˉ=gA→B+gB→A2.\bar g=\frac{g_{A\to B}+g_{B\to A}}{2}.gˉ​=2gA→B​+gB→A​​.

方向 margin

m=HB→A−HA→BHB→A+HA→B.m=\frac{H_{B\to A}-H_{A\to B}}{H_{B\to A}+H_{A\to B}}.m=HB→A​+HA→B​HB→A​−HA→B​​.

每個 RMSE 使用上述 ID 等權重。HA→BH_{A\to B}HA→B​ 是 A−A^baseA-\widehat A_{\mathrm{base}}A−Abase​ 與 B−B^fullB-\widehat B_{\mathrm{full}}B−Bfull​ 的 normalized kernel alignment；反向亦同。以兩殘差的距離建立 Gaussian 核、用權重中心化後：

H=∑i,jwiwjK~ijL~ij(∑i,jwiwjK~ij 2)(∑i,jwiwjL~ij 2)H=\frac{\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}\widetilde L_{ij}}{\sqrt{\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}^{\,2}\right)\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde L_{ij}^{\,2}\right)}}H=(∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij2​)(∑i,j​wi​wj​Lij2​)​∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij​Lij​​

若 gˉ≤g0\bar g\le g_0gˉ​≤g0​，輸出 no_edge；有增額資訊但 margin 不足或只允許棄權，輸出 unresolved。m>m0m>m_0m>m0​ 且 gA→B>0g_{A\to B}>0gA→B​>0 才畫 A→BA\to BA→B；m<−m0m<-m_0m<−m0​ 且反向 gB→A>0g_{B\to A}>0gB→A​>0 才畫 B→AB\to AB→A。樣本不足或數值失敗另記 invalid。

5.4 校準、matched null 與規則凍結

先完成 11 情境×30=330 次校準，另作 D11（高個體差異 null）與 D12（D9 品質困難的 null）共 60 次，並以 D6／D11 各 10 次補足少見條件，共使用 410 次校準資料凍結規則。D11／D12 是校準補充；正式驗證仍為 D0–D10，2,350 次。

觀測條件依序分組：完整配對缺失比例>0.15>0.15>0.15 或完整訪視中位數<3<3<3 為缺失／稀疏組；其餘若個體平均值變異／總變異>0.65>0.65>0.65 為高個體間變異組；其餘一般組。比值取 A／B 較大者。最終凍結流程對一般組用 D0／D1／D7、高變異組用 D11、稀疏組用 D12，要求各組校準的假箭頭或 invalid 比例≤0.05\le0.05≤0.05，再最大化可定向情境的分組平衡正確率。D8 保留為未量測混雜壓力測試，未列入最終硬性安全門檻。

gain 網格為 {0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}\{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10\}{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}，margin 網格為 {0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}\{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75\}{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}。每個組別／模型須至少有 20 個安全對照與 20 個可定向校準案例。最終個別模型 (g0,m0)(g_0,m_0)(g0​,m0​)：LMM (0.05,0.50)、GAM (0.01,0.20)、RF (0.01,0.30)、GPR (0.01,0.50)、MERF (0.01,0.30)；Mean 僅棄權。另凍結按可觀測組別選擇方向／曲線引擎的 policy。驗證資料與校準資料 seed 不重疊，門檻未依最終驗證結果回調。

5.5 影響曲線、轉折與效果修飾的評分

將已知真方向的三個完整迴歸模型預測取平均，於來源訓練第 5–95 百分位的 41 點估計中心化 PD。每點使用固定均勻抽取、最多 64 列乾淨參考資料。ALE 使用 12 個分位數區間；參考資料列決定各區間質量 qjq_jqj​，局部差累積至區間中點，再作質量加權中心化。

區間質量加權 ALE 誤差

ALEerrorrDirection=∑jqj(A^r,j−Ar,j)2sT,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Direction}}_r=\frac{\sqrt{\sum_j q_j(\widehat A_{r,j}-A_{r,j})^2}}{s_{T,r}}.ALEerrorrDirection​=sT,r​∑j​qj​(Ar,j​−Ar,j​)2​​.

高低修飾量的條件曲線差

D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)-P(x,Z=-0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).

sT,rs_{T,r}sT,r​ 是乾淨參考目標的 SD。Core 採格點等權，Direction 採區間質量加權；兩者的參考資料與標準化分母依各研究設定。D10 每條 P 先在來源格點中心化，再計算高低 Z 差，以消去 Z 的加法主效應；另沿訓練 Z 的第 5–95 百分位評整個條件反應面。

D4 的候選轉折以連續 hinge 最小平方法在內部格點搜尋，兩側至少各保留三點；相對線性擬合改善至少 10% 才記錄 knot。表格分別報告找到率與找到時的位置誤差。D10 另對來源 Q0.25→Q0.75Q_{0.25}\to Q_{0.75}Q0.25​→Q0.75​ 效果隨 Z 的曲線搜尋修飾轉折。這些是合成座標上的形狀診斷。

本研究的曲線分數是在真方向已知的條件下評分，目的在分開方向能力與函數能力。正式 bootstrap 次數為 0，沒有驗證曲線信賴帶、涵蓋率或整人重抽支持率。

LMM／GAM 在本比較中使用加法結構，其純交互作用對比誤差與 Mean 同為約 0.221。交互作用項與 tensor spline 的擴充規格列入後續比較。

07 Monte Carlo 不確定性、診斷與限制

7.1 平均值、MCSE 與配對差

平均值與 Monte Carlo 標準誤

θˉ=1R∑r=1Rθr,MCSE⁡(θˉ)=SD⁡(θ1,…,θR)R.\begin{aligned}\bar\theta&=\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}\theta_r,\\[0.9em]\operatorname{MCSE}(\bar\theta)&=\frac{\operatorname{SD}(\theta_1,\ldots,\theta_R)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}θˉMCSE(θˉ)​=R1​r=1∑R​θr​,=R​SD(θ1​,…,θR​)​.​

模型配對差與 Monte Carlo 區間

dr=θA,r−θB,r,CI0.95MC(dˉ)≈dˉ±1.96SD⁡(d)R.\begin{aligned}d_r&=\theta_{A,r}-\theta_{B,r},\\[0.9em]\mathrm{CI}^{\mathrm{MC}}_{0.95}(\bar d)&\approx\bar d\pm1.96\frac{\operatorname{SD}(d)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}dr​CI0.95MC​(dˉ)​=θA,r​−θB,r​,≈dˉ±1.96R​SD(d)​.​

replicate 是彙總的統計單位，同次模擬的兩模型以差值配對。雙因子曲線先在 replicate 內平均，再計算跨次平均與 MCSE。Core 表格呈現平均與 MCSE；Direction 率指標使用 Wilson 區間，連續指標使用近似 MC 區間。

每設定至少 200 次，需要時每批追加 25 次，上限 500。主要率指標的停止條件為 MCSE⁡≤0.03\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.03MCSE≤0.03，主要標準化連續指標為 MCSE⁡≤0.02\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.02MCSE≤0.02。Direction 對 0／1 邊界比例採 Jeffreys 平滑；Core 使用樣本 MCSE，全對或全錯時為 0。Core 的 484 項與 Direction 的 138 項預設主要精度檢查全部通過。

率差 ±0.05\pm0.05±0.05 定義描述性實務接近範圍；連續誤差的 5% 規則在 Core 以逐次 (A−B)/B(A-B)/B(A−B)/B 彙總，Direction 以 0.05×max(兩平均誤差) 定界。本文的 MC 區間採探索性分析設定，未校正多重比較與分批停止。

7.2 開發、校準與 seed 重疊

Core 先以 450 次 pilot 進行開發，再以小型校準調整 F1／F2／F3 的難度；正式結果使用凍結的 benchmark_v2 設定。正式 3,350 次中，390 次（11.6%）重用開發期的 train／test／evaluation seed 組合；開發結果另行彙總。

既有事後排除 seed 重疊的敏感度分析保留 2,960 次，直接從完成結果篩選，未重新擬合。各情境／模型 exact recovery 的最大平均變化約為 1.53 個百分點，ALE 約為 0.0100，latent RMSE 約為 0.0084。Direction 校準與驗證的 data seed 重疊數為 0；D11／D12 目前只納入校準。

7.3 輸出有效與數值估計品質

零最終失敗表示流程產生有限的評分結果。Core 的 GPR kernel 邊界命中率在新／已追蹤任務約 99.7%／98.7%，LMM fallback 約 82.5%／69.2%，MERF 達 25 次上限約 7.9%／9.9%。Direction 每模型有 28,200 個折內 fits；GPR 邊界約 87.0%，LMM fallback 約 81.6%，MERF 44.4% 觸及上限，平均迭代約 17.96。

模型診斷另保存 kernel 邊界、LMM fallback、MERF 迭代次數與停止狀態。MERF 的 GLL 相對變化門檻為 0.001，最大迭代次數為 25；達到上限的擬合仍保留其有限評分結果。

7.4 評估範圍與後續工作

  1. 因子選取。Core 使用已知真因子數 k、latent μ\muμ 與完整參考因子評分。null 選取門檻、FDR 與自動選 k 尚待建立。
  2. 相關與共同原因。Core 採 ID-block permutation；Direction 包含已量測與未量測共同原因情境，以量化增額預測與方向規則在這些條件下的表現。
  3. 曲線不確定性。正式 Direction bootstrap=0\mathrm{bootstrap}=0bootstrap=0。後續工作包括信賴帶涵蓋率、整個體重抽，以及轉折搜尋的網格敏感度。
  4. 縱向預測。本研究評估提供當次 X 的條件預測；未來因子建模、個體內與個體間效果分解列為後續工作。
  5. 完整網路。兩份研究目前分別評估單一結果的還原與一對 A/B 的方向證據。完整網路還原、跨模型投票與自動選模將另行比較。

方法參考

Peters et al.（2014）：連續加法噪音模型的因果辨識條件；Mooij et al.（2016）：因果方向 benchmark；Apley & Zhu（2020）：ALE 與預測變數效果的視覺化。本研究採 ID 加權、縱向 cross-fitting 與合成情境校準實作上述評估流程。

01 Research questions and formal scope

This benchmark compares six regression methods on small longitudinal samples. Two simulations use known data-generating mechanisms to assess factor ranking, response functions, prediction, and evidence about the direction of a relationship between two variables. Each task has its own evaluation target. All formal scenarios and model results are reported by task.

1.1 Questions addressed by the two studies

Study I (Core) asks whether a model can recover the factors that directly enter the outcome equation among 14 candidates, reconstruct linear and nonlinear response functions, detect slope changes and effect modification, and predict outcomes for new individuals or individuals with an observed history.

Study II (Direction) asks whether A and B provide incremental predictive information after adjustment, when a shared evidence procedure issues A→BA\to BA→B or B→AB\to AB→A, and when it retains an unresolved direction. Response curves and effect modification are evaluated separately, conditional on the known generating direction.

A replicate consists of newly generated data, model fitting, and evaluation. All six models share the data and evaluation conditions within a replicate, allowing paired comparisons. The counts above include formal results only; development, calibration, and supplementary diagnostics are described separately.

This simulation study forms part of the author’s project in collaboration with National Taiwan University Hospital, but uses no patient information. All data used in the simulations are synthetic. This page presents their generating mechanisms, evaluation methods, and aggregate results.

02 Compared methods and shared implementation

2.1 Six regression methods

  • Mean: predicts the mean of the training outcome.
  • LMM: combines linear fixed effects and individual random intercepts; estimated individual effects are used when a history is available.
  • GAM: estimates response functions with additive spline bases and a ridge penalty.
  • RF: averages predictions from regression trees.
  • GPR: uses a kernel to describe input similarity and estimate the response function.
  • MERF: alternates between a forest fixed component and individual random intercepts; estimated individual effects are used when a history is available.

GPR noise bounds are [10−5,10][10^{-5},10][10−5,10] in both studies. Study II fixes the kernel family while estimating its continuous parameters from training data. MERF stops early at relative GLL change 0.001. The GAM implementation is additive spline–ridge regression. LMM and GAM receive no additional true interaction term.

2.2 Common information and grouping by individual

Models share each generated dataset, grouped splits, and reference data. ID defines grouping, random effects, and evaluation. Median imputation, missingness indicators, feature scaling, and target scaling are learned within the relevant training data and then applied to held-out data. True factor lists, curves, and arrows are unavailable during fitting.

All models share the data and available information. Model flexibility, computational cost, and Study I forest sizes follow Table 2. The RF–MERF comparison evaluates the full model specifications rather than an experiment that varies only the random intercept.

3.3 Response functions, decoys, missingness, and contamination

Three base functions

hlinear(x)=x,hsmooth(x)=0.8sin⁡(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),hhinge(x)=max⁡(0,x−0.25).\begin{aligned}h_{\mathrm{linear}}(x)&=x,\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{smooth}}(x)&=0.8\sin(\pi x/2)+0.2(x^2-1),\\[0.9em]h_{\mathrm{hinge}}(x)&=\max(0,x-0.25).\end{aligned}hlinear​(x)hsmooth​(x)hhinge​(x)​=x,=0.8sin(πx/2)+0.2(x2−1),=max(0,x−0.25).​

Centering and standardization

h~q(x)=hq(x)−E[hq(G)]SD⁡[hq(G)],G∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.\begin{aligned}\widetilde h_q(x)&=\frac{h_q(x)-\mathbb{E}[h_q(G)]}{\operatorname{SD}[h_q(G)]},\\[0.9em]G&\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1),\qquad q\in\{\mathrm{linear},\mathrm{smooth},\mathrm{hinge}\}.\end{aligned}hq​(x)G​=SD[hq​(G)]hq​(x)−E[hq​(G)]​,∼N(0,1),q∈{linear,smooth,hinge}.​

The outcome equation uses standardized functions such as h~smooth\widetilde h_{\mathrm{smooth}}hsmooth​ and h~hinge\widetilde h_{\mathrm{hinge}}hhinge​, multiplied by the scenario coefficient. Centering and scaling constants use deterministic 64-point Gauss–Hermite quadrature. Actual X distributions remain those generated above. Realized signal variance and R2R^2R2 depend on both function shape and input distribution. In S4 the first function is multiplied by (1+0.75DM)(1+0.75\mathrm{DM})(1+0.75DM), and the second is linear. The default second coefficient is 2/3 of the first; F1 uses 0.35 and F3 uses 0.50.

A decoy is D=rX~+1−r2 E~D=r\widetilde X+\sqrt{1-r^2}\,\widetilde ED=rX+1−r2​E, where X~\widetilde XX is the sample-standardized first factor and E~\widetilde EE is orthogonal to X~\widetilde XX in the complete sample. The generator sets r as an exact sample correlation before missingness. Decoys do not enter μ\muμ directly.

In F3 and S9, each candidate-factor cell is missing with probability p=clip⁡(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0.01,0.65)p=\operatorname{clip}(0.20[0.55+0.70\mathrm{DM}+0.45\mathrm{late}],0.01,0.65)p=clip(0.20[0.55+0.70DM+0.45late],0.01,0.65), where late denotes the second half of visits. This MAR mechanism depends on observed DM and time; it does not mask the outcome. A fixed random 20% of IDs lose their second-half visits: the 50×4 design retains 180 of 200 rows and all 50 IDs. S9 selects a fixed 5% of scheduled rows for positive Uniform⁡(2,3)\operatorname{Uniform}(2,3)Uniform(2,3) contamination before outcome clipping and visit retention.

3.5 Complete workflow within a replicate

  1. Generate common training data and an independent test set. The test set has 2,000 new IDs. Both datasets receive the specified missingness, dropout, and contamination.
  2. Select settings within training data. GAM, RF, GPR, and MERF use 3-fold GroupKFold and ID-balanced MSE. The best candidate is refitted on all training data. Mean and LMM have one candidate and no candidate search.
  3. Predict new individuals. Models use the common test set; LMM/MERF use zero individual effects for new IDs. The primary latent target is μ\muμ. Observed RMSE, MAE, and R2R^2R2 are retained separately.
  4. Evaluate factors and functions. The complete latent test data for the first 250 IDs provide an oracle evaluation reference. ID-trajectory permutation is repeated three times per candidate. Model and true ALE use 20 quantile bins.
  5. Evaluate individuals with history. Hold out the last observed visit of each eligible training ID. Retune and refit using earlier history. Supply current X at the held-out visit; LMM/MERF may use the ID's estimated effect. The latent target is μ+b\mu+bμ+b.
  6. Save and aggregate. Retain metrics, warnings, and completion status. Compute means and MCSE across replicates, pairing model differences within the same replicate.

3.6 Mathematical definitions of the metrics

For true factor set KrK_rKr​ and the top-kkk importance set TrT_rTr​, define Er=1{Tr=Kr}E_r=\mathbf{1}\{T_r=K_r\}Er​=1{Tr​=Kr​}, with k=∣Kr∣k=|K_r|k=∣Kr​∣. Exact recovery is 1R∑r=1REr\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}E_rR1​∑r=1R​Er​. Importance is the permutation increase in MSE against μ\muμ, divided by clean outcome variance. AP summarizes true-factor positions in the complete ranking. Family recovery allows a designated same-family decoy to represent a signal source. These ranking metrics are undefined for S0, with k=0k=0k=0, and for Mean.

Standardized ALE error

ALEerrorr,kCore=1J∑j=1J(A^r,k,j−Ar,k,j)2sY,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Core}}_{r,k}=\frac{\sqrt{\frac{1}{J}\sum_{j=1}^{J}(\widehat A_{r,k,j}-A_{r,k,j})^2}}{s_{Y,r}}.ALEerrorr,kCore​=sY,r​J1​∑j=1J​(Ar,k,j​−Ar,k,j​)2​​.

Latent RMSE for new individuals

LatentRMSErnew=1n∑i,t(y^it−μit)2.\mathrm{LatentRMSE}^{\mathrm{new}}_r=\sqrt{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i,t}(\widehat y_{it}-\mu_{it})^2}.LatentRMSErnew​=n1​i,t∑​(y​it​−μit​)2​.

A^\widehat AA and A are centered model and true ALE curves. Centering uses bin counts, while the error gives equal weight to valid grid points. The denominator sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​ is the SD of the complete clean reference outcome. Two-factor errors are averaged within a replicate before aggregation. The known-ID task replaces μ\muμ by μ+b\mu+bμ+b. Primary latent RMSE weights retained evaluation rows equally; ID-balanced observed-error variants are also available in the download.

For S4, 15 first-factor quantiles between the 5th and 95th percentiles crossed with DM∈{0,1}\mathrm{DM}\in\{0,1\}DM∈{0,1} yield 30 combinations. Predictions and truth are averaged over common reference data, centered over the entire surface, compared by RMSE, and divided by sY,rs_{Y,r}sY,r​. This metric evaluates the complete joint response surface, including main effects.

The five scientific models attain 100% in S1, S2, S3, and S6. In S4 all attain 100% except GPR at 99.5%. Factor ranking is near its ceiling in these settings, while function and prediction errors still differ. F1 results are GAM 94.9%, MERF 93.5%, RF 92.4%, LMM 76.4%, and GPR 40.7%. GPR includes the first and second factor in its top two approximately 97.8% and 42.9% of the time; its main weakness is the weak secondary factor.

RF has the highest F2 mean at 83.3%, followed by MERF at 81.5%. Four models attain 100% family recovery while exact recovery is about 66%–83%, revealing difficulty distinguishing a direct factor from highly correlated substitutes. GAM has the highest mean in F3 (75.3%) and S9 (53.3%). All methods miss factors under combined difficulties.

Threshold_location_error is |estimated location−0.25| in synthetic factor coordinates. Core uses ALE grid points from 20 quantile bins, calculates slopes between adjacent points, and selects the interior point with the largest absolute change between adjacent slopes. In two-factor S9, the two errors are averaged within each replicate before calculating means, MCSE, and descriptive ranks.

MERF’s mean S3/S9 location errors are 0.504/0.475, compared with RF at 0.529/0.502, and are lower than those of the other specified methods. Core defines the location as the interior ALE grid point with the largest adjacent-slope change. Grid spacing varies with each data distribution, and the metric evaluates this discrete location. Mean’s flat curve has undefined location.

5.2 All formal scenarios

D0 No direct relationship after adjustmentR=200R = 200R=200

Purpose
Measure false-arrow decisions when there is no additional direct A–B relationship.
Conditions
Each replicate contains 50 synthetic individuals observed at months 3, 6, 9, and 12, giving 200 scheduled observations. The adjustment set C contains time, Age, Sex, DM, HTN, CKD, and Z; this study does not impose the Core biomarker or decoy design. The direct effect is f(S,Z)=0f(S,Z)=0f(S,Z)=0. A and B retain background variation due to shared controls, with no additional common cause. The innovation ICC parameter is 0.25. Total innovation SD is 1 for the source and 0.70 for the target, with the same within-individual correlation structure. Both individual-level and visit-level innovations are Gaussian. No missing A/B values, visit dropout, or outlier contamination is imposed. Outcomes use neutral synthetic units and are not clipped to [0,8][0,8][0,8].
Interpretation
The generating graph in D0 contains no direct A–B edge. Results are summarized as no_edge, unresolved, false_arrow, and invalid decisions, with the false_arrow rate measuring erroneous orientation.
Result tables →

D1 A direction-nonidentifiable linear Gaussian controlR=200R = 200R=200

Purpose
Check whether the procedure retains uncertainty when the stated assumptions do not uniquely identify direction.
Conditions
Each replicate contains 50 synthetic individuals observed at months 3, 6, 9, and 12, giving 200 scheduled observations. The adjustment set C contains time, Age, Sex, DM, HTN, CKD, and Z; this study does not impose the Core biomarker or decoy design. The direct effect is f(S,Z)=±0.60Sf(S,Z)=\pm0.60Sf(S,Z)=±0.60S. Source and target noise have matched longitudinal correlation structures, and the scenario is marked direction-nonidentifiable. The innovation ICC parameter is 0.25. Total innovation SD is 1 for the source and 0.70 for the target, with the same within-individual correlation structure. Both individual-level and visit-level innovations are Gaussian. No missing A/B values, visit dropout, or outlier contamination is imposed. Outcomes use neutral synthetic units and are not clipped to [0,8][0,8][0,8].
Interpretation
A and B have an incremental predictive relationship. D1 is scored as a nonidentifiable control, with arrow decisions counted as false_arrow. Results summarize arrows, unresolved decisions, and decisions detecting no incremental relationship.
Result tables →

D2 Linear effects with non-Gaussian innovationsR=225R = 225R=225

Purpose
Relative to D1, test whether changing the noise distribution produces useful residual-asymmetry evidence for direction.
Conditions
Each replicate contains 50 synthetic individuals observed at months 3, 6, 9, and 12, giving 200 scheduled observations. The adjustment set C contains time, Age, Sex, DM, HTN, CKD, and Z; this study does not impose the Core biomarker or decoy design. The direct effect remains f(S,Z)=±0.60Sf(S,Z)=\pm0.60Sf(S,Z)=±0.60S. The innovation ICC parameter is 0.25. Total innovation SD is 1 for the source and 0.70 for the target, with the same within-individual correlation structure. Individual-level and visit-level innovations for the source, target, and Z use Laplace⁡(0,1)/2\operatorname{Laplace}(0,1)/\sqrt{2}Laplace(0,1)/2​, giving unit variance to each underlying innovation. No missing A/B values, visit dropout, or outlier contamination is imposed. Outcomes use neutral synthetic units and are not clipped to [0,8][0,8][0,8].
Interpretation
D1 and D2 differ in innovation distribution. D2 assesses direction decisions under the specified Laplace innovations through the proportions of correct arrows, wrong arrows, unresolved decisions, no-edge decisions, and invalid outcomes.

5.3 Three-fold cross-fitting and directional evidence

  1. Use common complete A/B rows. Direction analysis uses complete pairs without imputing missing targets. Models and both directions share those rows.
  2. Split by ID into three folds. Each training split fits A∼CA\sim CA∼C, B∼CB\sim CB∼C, A∼C+BA\sim C+BA∼C+B, and B∼C+AB\sim C+AB∼C+A. Transformations use training-fold information only. Held-out-ID LMM/MERF predictions do not use estimated effects for that ID.
  3. Combine out-of-fold predictions. A row from ID i with viv_ivi​ complete visits has weight wit=1NIDviw_{it}=\frac{1}{N_{\mathrm{ID}}v_i}wit​=NID​vi​1​, giving each individual equal total weight.
  4. Calculate incremental gain and residual dependence. Relative RMSE improvements measure additional information. Residual kernel alignment in the two directions provides a margin.
  5. Apply thresholds frozen before validation. Retain no incremental relationship detected, unresolved direction, A→BA\to BA→B, B→AB\to AB→A, or invalid, together with continuous gains and margins.
  6. Evaluate shape separately. The known generating direction and 200 independently generated clean reference IDs are used only for curve scoring.

Directional incremental prediction gain

gA→B=RMSEB∼C−RMSEB∼C+ARMSEB∼C.g_{A\to B}=\frac{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}-\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C+A}}{\mathrm{RMSE}_{B\sim C}}.gA→B​=RMSEB∼C​RMSEB∼C​−RMSEB∼C+A​​.

Mean gain across directions

gˉ=gA→B+gB→A2.\bar g=\frac{g_{A\to B}+g_{B\to A}}{2}.gˉ​=2gA→B​+gB→A​​.

Directional margin

m=HB→A−HA→BHB→A+HA→B.m=\frac{H_{B\to A}-H_{A\to B}}{H_{B\to A}+H_{A\to B}}.m=HB→A​+HA→B​HB→A​−HA→B​​.

RMSE uses the ID-balanced weights above. HA→BH_{A\to B}HA→B​ is normalized kernel alignment between A−A^baseA-\widehat A_{\mathrm{base}}A−Abase​ and B−B^fullB-\widehat B_{\mathrm{full}}B−Bfull​; the reverse direction is analogous. Gaussian residual kernels are centered with the weights, giving:

H=∑i,jwiwjK~ijL~ij(∑i,jwiwjK~ij 2)(∑i,jwiwjL~ij 2)H=\frac{\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}\widetilde L_{ij}}{\sqrt{\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde K_{ij}^{\,2}\right)\left(\sum_{i,j}w_iw_j\widetilde L_{ij}^{\,2}\right)}}H=(∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij2​)(∑i,j​wi​wj​Lij2​)​∑i,j​wi​wj​Kij​Lij​​

Kernel scales use median positive squared distances.

If gˉ≤g0\bar g\le g_0gˉ​≤g0​, the output is no_edge. Incremental information with inadequate margin, or an abstain-only rule, produces unresolved. A→BA\to BA→B requires m>m0m>m_0m>m0​ and gA→B>0g_{A\to B}>0gA→B​>0; B→AB\to AB→A requires m<−m0m<-m_0m<−m0​ and positive reverse gain. Insufficient data or numerical failure is invalid.

5.4 Calibration, matched nulls, and frozen rules

Calibration first used 11×30=330 replicates. D11, a high-heterogeneity null, and D12, a null with D9 data-quality difficulties, contributed 60 more. Ten additional D6 and ten D11 replicates filled a less common observable group, giving 410 calibration replicates for the final freeze. D11/D12 are calibration supplements; formal validation contains D0–D10 and 2,350 replicates.

Observable groups are assigned sequentially: pair missing fraction>0.15>0.15>0.15 or median complete visits<3<3<3 defines missing/sparse; otherwise an individual-mean variance / total variance ratio>0.65>0.65>0.65 defines high between-ID variation; remaining data are ordinary. The ratio is the larger value for A/B. Final freezing uses D0/D1/D7 for ordinary safety controls, D11 for high-variation controls, and D12 for sparse controls. Each group's calibration false-arrow or invalid rate must be ≤0.05\le0.05≤0.05 before maximizing group-balanced correct direction. D8 is retained as a hidden-confounding stress, excluded from final hard safety controls.

The gain grid is {0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}\{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10\}{0,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.10}; the margin grid is {0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}\{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75\}{0.05,0.10,0.20,0.30,0.50,0.75}. Each group/model requires at least 20 safety controls and 20 direction-eligible calibration cases. Frozen individual-model (g0,m0)(g_0,m_0)(g0​,m0​) values are LMM (0.05,0.50), GAM (0.01,0.20), RF (0.01,0.30), GPR (0.01,0.50), and MERF (0.01,0.30). Mean only abstains. A separate policy selects direction/shape engines using observable groups. Validation and calibration data seeds do not overlap; thresholds were not adjusted after observing final validation results.

5.5 Curves, slope changes, and effect modification

Predictions from the three full regressions in the true direction are averaged. Centered PD is evaluated at 41 source points between training quantiles 5% and 95%, using up to 64 deterministically, uniformly selected clean reference rows per point. ALE uses 12 quantile bins. Reference rows determine bin masses qjq_jqj​; local differences accumulate to bin midpoints and are centered using these masses.

Bin-mass-weighted ALE error

ALEerrorrDirection=∑jqj(A^r,j−Ar,j)2sT,r.\mathrm{ALEerror}^{\mathrm{Direction}}_r=\frac{\sqrt{\sum_j q_j(\widehat A_{r,j}-A_{r,j})^2}}{s_{T,r}}.ALEerrorrDirection​=sT,r​∑j​qj​(Ar,j​−Ar,j​)2​​.

Conditional-curve contrast at high and low modifier levels

D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)-P(x,Z=-0.50).D(x)=P(x,Z=0.75)−P(x,Z=−0.50).

The denominator sT,rs_{T,r}sT,r​ is clean reference-target SD. Core weights grid errors equally, while Direction weights them by bin mass. Reference data and standardizing denominators follow the respective study designs. In D10 each P is first centered over source grid points before subtracting high/low Z curves, removing additive Z main effects. A conditional response surface is also evaluated across training Z quantiles 5%–95%.

D4 candidate knots minimize continuous-hinge least squares over interior points, leaving at least three grid points on each side. A knot requires at least 10% improvement over a linear fit. The tables report detection frequency and location error conditional on detection separately. D10 additionally fits a knot to the source Q0.25→Q0.75Q_{0.25}\to Q_{0.75}Q0.25​→Q0.75​ effect as a function of Z. These are shape diagnostics in synthetic coordinates.

Curve scores condition on the true direction to separate directional and functional ability. Formal bootstrap repetitions are 0. Curve confidence bands, coverage, and whole-individual resampling support were not validated.

07 Monte Carlo uncertainty, diagnostics, and limitations

7.1 Means, MCSE, and paired differences

Mean and Monte Carlo standard error

θˉ=1R∑r=1Rθr,MCSE⁡(θˉ)=SD⁡(θ1,…,θR)R.\begin{aligned}\bar\theta&=\frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R}\theta_r,\\[0.9em]\operatorname{MCSE}(\bar\theta)&=\frac{\operatorname{SD}(\theta_1,\ldots,\theta_R)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}θˉMCSE(θˉ)​=R1​r=1∑R​θr​,=R​SD(θ1​,…,θR​)​.​

Paired model difference and Monte Carlo interval

dr=θA,r−θB,r,CI0.95MC(dˉ)≈dˉ±1.96SD⁡(d)R.\begin{aligned}d_r&=\theta_{A,r}-\theta_{B,r},\\[0.9em]\mathrm{CI}^{\mathrm{MC}}_{0.95}(\bar d)&\approx\bar d\pm1.96\frac{\operatorname{SD}(d)}{\sqrt R}.\end{aligned}dr​CI0.95MC​(dˉ)​=θA,r​−θB,r​,≈dˉ±1.96R​SD(d)​.​

The replicate is the aggregation unit. Model differences are paired within each replicate. Two-factor curve errors are averaged within replicates before computing cross-replicate means and MCSE. Core tables report means and MCSE. Direction proportions use Wilson intervals, and continuous metrics use approximate MC intervals.

Each setting requires at least 200 replicates, with additions of 25 if needed and a ceiling of 500. The stopping condition is MCSE⁡≤0.03\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.03MCSE≤0.03 for main rates and MCSE⁡≤0.02\operatorname{MCSE}\le0.02MCSE≤0.02 for main standardized continuous metrics. Direction uses Jeffreys smoothing at 0/1 boundaries. Core uses sample MCSE, which equals zero when all outcomes agree. All 484 Core and 138 Direction prespecified main precision checks passed.

A rate difference of ±0.05\pm0.05±0.05 defines descriptive practical closeness. For continuous errors, Core aggregates replicate-relative (A−B)/B(A-B)/B(A−B)/B with a 5% margin, while Direction uses 0.05×max(the two mean errors). The MC intervals follow an exploratory analysis specification without multiplicity or sequential-stopping corrections.

7.2 Development, calibration, and seed overlap

Core used 450 development-pilot replicates, followed by small calibrations of F1/F2/F3 difficulty. Formal results use frozen benchmark_v2 settings. Among 3,350 formal replicates, 390 (11.6%) reuse development train/test/evaluation seed combinations. Development results are aggregated separately.

An existing sensitivity analysis excludes seed-overlap replicates and retains 2,960 completed results without refitting. The largest scenario/model mean changes are about 1.53 percentage points for exact recovery, 0.0100 for ALE, and 0.0084 for latent RMSE. Direction has zero data-seed overlap between calibration and validation. D11/D12 currently contribute only to calibration.

7.3 Valid outputs and numerical estimation quality

Zero final failures means that finite evaluation results were produced. In Core, GPR kernel-boundary rates are about 99.7%/98.7% for new/known-ID tasks, LMM fallback rates 82.5%/69.2%, and MERF maximum-iteration rates 7.9%/9.9%. Direction has 28,200 fold-specific fits per model; GPR boundaries occur in about 87.0%, LMM fallback in 81.6%, and MERF reaches its limit in 44.4%, with mean iterations about 17.96.

Model diagnostics record kernel boundaries, LMM fallback, MERF iteration counts, and stopping states. MERF uses relative GLL change 0.001 and a maximum of 25 iterations. Fits reaching the limit retain their finite evaluation results.

7.4 Evaluation scope and further work

  1. Factor selection.Core uses known true factor count k, latent μ\muμ, and complete reference factors for scoring. Null selection thresholds, FDR, and automatic choice of k remain to be developed.
  2. Correlation and common causes.Core uses ID-block permutation. Direction includes observed and hidden common-cause scenarios to quantify incremental prediction and directional rules under these conditions.
  3. Curve uncertainty.Formal Direction bootstrap=0\mathrm{bootstrap}=0bootstrap=0. Further work includes confidence-band coverage, whole-individual resampling, and grid sensitivity in knot searches.
  4. Longitudinal prediction.This study evaluates conditional prediction with current X supplied. Future-factor modeling and within-/between-individual effect decomposition are reserved for further work.
  5. Complete networks.The two studies currently evaluate recovery for one outcome and directional evidence for one A/B pair. Network recovery, model voting, and automatic model selection will be compared separately.

08 Public aggregates and traceable sources

Page values are generated from reviewed aggregate CSV files. The manifest records source and output SHA-256 hashes. TOML files provide synthetic data-generating settings, and the download links point to the website data package. Public versions of the complete source and execution environment are still being prepared.
